item.title: Obsession Director Reveals Surprise New Release Coming This Week
item.description: Obsession had an incredible box office run and quickly became the talk of the town. Director Curry Barker amassed thousands of fans all over the world within weeks. Barker is currently working on Anything but Ghosts , a comedy-horror flick set for release in 2027, but there's something that fans can look forward to before then. The director is going back to his YouTube roots between big-screen productions with a new short film, Mama Bear .

item.title: BioWare Was Asked to Remove LGBTQ Flag from Canceled Mass Effect Game, Report Says
item.description: Electronic Arts game properties such as Mass Effect , Dragon Age, and The Sims have long included same-sex romance, but the buyout by Saudi Arabia's private investment fund (PIF), Jared Kushner's Affinity Partners, and private equity fund Silver Lake changed things. For example, The Sims 2 physical edition cover shows different Sims in several poses, including a couple kissing and an alien. In Saudi Arabia, the cover art was completely modified to feature a handful of dull-looking male Sims standing emotionless.

item.title: 25 Years Later, Nintendo’s Spookiest Game Is a Must-Play On Switch 2
item.description: Looking back at Nintendo hardware, dates often get separated from reality. We tend to develop a picture of a Mario platformer serving as an ever-present anchor, one hardware launch after another. That’s not always the case, though. Super Mario World arrived alongside the Super Nintendo in 1991, and Super Mario 64 was the star of the Nintendo 64 in 1996, but more recent hardware has frequently launched without that safeguard.

item.title: The Rings of Power Season 3 Will Be a Soft Reboot, Showrunner Says
item.description: If you have not caught up yet with the 16 episodes of the first two seasons of Prime Video's The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power , don't sweat it. According to co-showrunner Patrick McKay, you may not need to, as season 3 of the show will be the start of "a whole new story."

item.title: 18 Years Later, The Definitive 2000s Gothic Cult Classic is Still a Divisive Guilty Pleasure
item.description: The anime equivalent of Twilight also centers on a messy love triangle in a dark supernatural world, but it takes its story to even more controversial places. Based on Matsuri Hino’s classic shojo manga, the 2008 Studio Deen anime Vampire Knight is a unique relic of the late 2000s.

item.title: Legendary Sci-Fi Director's 129-Minute War-Action Masterpiece Is Being Cut From Netflix
item.description: When legendary director Paul Verhoeven's space action epic arrived in theaters 29 years ago, a lot of people didn’t get it . While the original 1959 novel by Robert A. Heinlein had a militaristic right-wing viewpoint, Verhoeven and screenwriter Edward Neumeier sought to lampoon those themes when they adapted it for the screen in 1997. Unfortunately, a number of critics mistook the movie’s satire for sincerity. The Washington Post , for example, called the movie “Nazi to the core.”

item.title: 5 Funniest 'Peanuts' Comics About Snoopy's Forgotten Siblings
item.description: Charles Schulz's Snoopy is one of the most famous fictional dogs in the world, if not the most famous. His only real competition might be Goofy, who's apparently supposed to be an anthropomorphic dog (which, as ever, raises some real uncomfortable questions about Pluto), or possibly Scooby-Doo.

item.title: 29 Years Ago, ‘Buffy’s Wisest Character Got a Shocking Backstory that Redefined the Entire Series
item.description: In Buffy the Vampire Slayer , Halloween is the one night a year when monsters think it’s cliché to go out and torment the Hellmouth. As Buffy elegantly puts it: Halloween is “like, dead for the undead.” But 29 years ago, one evildoer decided to wreak havoc in Sunnydale on the one night no one expected. The result was an episode that explored the characters' deepest insecurities and gave the Scooby Gang an unexpected hero: Rupert Giles (Anthony Head), the fussy librarian who until then had served as Buffy’s moral compass and cheerleader. While he ended up saving the day, the episode added a wrinkle to his character, introducing his mysterious past as "Ripper."

item.title: The MCU's Oldest Villain Just Made a Surprise Return in 'VisionQuest'
item.description: In the 2008 movie Iron Man , the biggest, baddest villain was Obadiah Stane, played by Jeff Bridges. Originally business partners with Tony Stark (Robert Downey Jr.), Obadiah betrayed Tony by hatching a plot to kill him while he was in Afghanistan. When Tony survived and became Iron Man, Obadiah responded by taking on his own iron identity: The Iron Monger.
